what: A shader gradient across the whole board — from the color center it spreads light lime → green → deep green (distance 0~.3 · .2~1), while a separate teal water ring (radius .6~.9 · thickness .45~.8) ripples with a sine wave spreading from the color center (frequency 1.2 · strength .8), getting 10% brighter at each crest. Changing data-mode makes the two centers drift to new positions over 3 seconds (power3.inOut). intro (center) → top (bottom-left corner, water ring 1.15 down) moves 1.5 seconds late while the film (deep green) covers and clears over 2 seconds, and navi spins the waves five beats faster over 2 seconds. footer puts the color center at the height data-y (footer height / window height)
ease: power3.inOut (position change) · power2.inOut (intro·top) · sine.inOut (navi wave) · power1.inOut (curtain)

options.amp: Wave strength (initial value — 1 after intro→top), default .8
options.speed: Wave flow speed (phase per second), default 1
options.data-mode: intro · top · normal · navi · footer — it flows in that Type each time you switch (an attribute of the element, not an option)
options.data-y: Color center height (0~1) in the footer type — footer height / window height
options.--fx-grad-0 ~ 3: Four colors (center, middle, outer, water ring) — by default taken from --kf-accent and --kf-accent-soft

use: — If the body background is left empty, it shows through there. To change the Type: bg.dataset.mode = "footer"; bg.dataset.y = footer.offsetHeight / innerHeight

from.where: [data-fx laid down after shared.js=ripple-gradient-bg] — original gradientBg (three r164 ShaderMaterial, types intro·top·normal·navi·footer)

note: The original shader was rewritten with the same formulas (the original also doesn’t turn on the blur post-process). On narrow screens the pattern scales up to 3x and the water rings are smaller (top .45 · others .7). With reduced motion the waves stop and position shifts finish instantly. If WebGL is unavailable, only the accent-color background remains
